The '''1736 [[FLLA]] World Cup''' was the 17th edition of the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international [[Arraby]] tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of the [[FLLA]]. It was held in [[Verusa]] across [[Ayuma]], and was won by [[Raledria]], who defeated [[Verusa]] 3-1 in the final.

Hosted by [[Verusa]] and remembered for an unusual second-half incident in which the floodlights at the final venue failed for thirty-six minutes, the 1736 tournament was won by [[Raledria]] who defeated the hosts 3-1 in the final. The result extended Raledria's record to four FLLA World Cup titles, while Verusa became the first nation to reach a World Cup final on home soil without lifting the trophy.
